caption_fb:
Heard a new family story this Christmas? Write it down today.

Memory fades fast after the holidays. Put everything on one sheet:
🔹 full names, including Polish first names and maiden names
🔹 every place name, spelled the way it sounded
🔹 dates, even "around 1910"
🔹 who told you, and when

That one page is your starting point. The Clue Sheet in the Beginning guide is made for this, $9.
👉 https://www.etsy.com/shop/SeekTheCradle
